evals.prompt: Generate a 30 second chill lo-fi beat using Mubert API
evals.expected_output: Code that POSTs to /api/v3/public/tracks with prompt, duration=30, and correct authentication headers
assertions: The code sends a POST request to https://music-api.mubert.com/api/v3/public/tracks
The request body includes a 'prompt' field with a music description
The request body includes 'duration' set to 30
The request includes 'customer-id' and 'access-token' headers

The response ends with a credentials onboarding block that mentions MUBERT_CUSTOMER_ID and MUBERT_ACCESS_TOKEN, asks about single user vs multi-user usage, and suggests saying 'set up Mubert' or references the mubert-setup skill

evals.prompt: Create an energetic 60-second track from playlist P001 in WAV format at 320kbps
evals.expected_output: Code that POSTs to /public/tracks with playlist_index='P001', duration=60, format='wav', bitrate=320, intensity='high'
assertions: The code sends a POST request to /api/v3/public/tracks
The request body includes 'playlist_index' set to 'P001'
The request body includes 'duration' set to 60
The request body includes 'format' set to 'wav'
The request body includes 'bitrate' set to 320
The request includes correct authentication headers

evals.prompt: Remove drums and vocals from track abc-123
evals.expected_output: Code that POSTs to /public/tracks/abc-123/edit with delete_instruments or delete_stems containing DRUMS and VOCALS
assertions: The code sends a POST request to /api/v3/public/tracks/abc-123/edit
The request body uses 'delete_instruments' or 'delete_stems'
The deletion list includes DRUMS (or the DRUMS stem)
The deletion list includes VOCALS
The request includes correct authentication headers

evals.prompt: Replace the bass and leads in track xyz-456 with new ones
evals.expected_output: Code that POSTs to /public/tracks/xyz-456/edit with replace_instruments or replace_stems containing BASS and LEADS
assertions: The code sends a POST request to /api/v3/public/tracks/xyz-456/edit
The request body uses 'replace_instruments' or 'replace_stems'
The replacement list includes BASS
The replacement list includes LEADS
The request includes correct authentication headers

evals.prompt: Generate a track similar to track abc-123 but as a 45 second loop
evals.expected_output: Code that POSTs to /public/tracks/abc-123/similar with duration=45 and mode='loop'
assertions: The code sends a POST request to /api/v3/public/tracks/abc-123/similar
The request body includes 'duration' set to 45
The request body includes 'mode' set to 'loop'
The request includes correct authentication headers

evals.expected_output: Code that GETs /public/playlists with correct headers
assertions: The code sends a GET request to /api/v3/public/playlists
The request includes 'customer-id' and 'access-token' headers
The code parses and displays the playlist data

evals.prompt: Generate a track from an image file photo.jpg using Mubert
evals.expected_output: Code that POSTs to /public/tracks with multipart/form-data containing the image file and duration
assertions: The code sends a POST request to /api/v3/public/tracks
The request uses multipart/form-data content type
The request includes an 'image' field with the file
The request includes a 'duration' field
The request includes correct authentication headers

evals.prompt: I want to generate a track but I don't have API credentials yet
evals.expected_output: The agent should recognize that credentials are missing and guide the user to use mubert-setup skill to obtain and configure credentials
assertions: The response mentions the need for customer-id and access-token
The response references mubert-setup skill for obtaining and configuring credentials
The response asks about single-user vs multi-user usage pattern

evals.prompt: Write a TypeScript function that generates a Mubert track and polls until it's ready
evals.expected_output: TypeScript code that POSTs to /public/tracks, then GETs /public/tracks/{id} in a polling loop checking generation status
assertions: The code is written in TypeScript
The code sends a POST to /api/v3/public/tracks to create the track
The code sends GET requests to /api/v3/public/tracks/{id} to poll status
The code checks the generation status field before returning
The code includes correct authentication headers in all requests
